title: ParamSpec
description: Parameter specification exposed to the phone (SRD 7.6). The phone may pre-validate; the daemon is authoritative. Unknown fields are ignored (PROTO-002).

name.description: Parameter name used in argv templating.

label.description: Field label shown on the phone.

required.description: Whether the parameter must be supplied.

default.description: Default value; its type follows 'type'. Any JSON value is allowed.

pattern.description: Regular expression a string value must match.

secret.description: Whether the value must never be logged or echoed back.

placeholder.description: Hint text shown in the empty field.
